Class Bio7Grid

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.rbridge.Bio7Grid
public class Bio7Grid extends Object
This class gives access to the Table component (based on the Nebula Grid Widget) of Bio7.

    • columnName

      public static String columnName(int index)
      Returns the title of a column of a sheet like in a spreadsheet: A, B, ..., Z, AA, AB, ... (the title of the columns of the Bio7 table, e.g., for ranges of cells like B2:B51).
      Parameters:
      index - the index of the column (0 based)
      Returns:
      the title

    • isFitted

      public static boolean isFitted(org.eclipse.nebula.widgets.grid.Grid grid)
      Returns true if the columns of a sheet are fitted to the content (see fitColumns).

    • fitColumns

      public static void fitColumns(org.eclipse.nebula.widgets.grid.Grid grid, boolean fit)
      Fits the widths of the columns of a sheet to the content (the widest text of a column and its title, at most 600 points) or restores the widths before (in the user interface thread). For large sheets the texts with the most characters of each column are measured.
      Parameters:
      grid - the sheet
      fit - true fits the columns, false restores the widths before

    • toSWTImage

      public static org.eclipse.swt.graphics.Image toSWTImage(BufferedImage bufferedImage)
      Creates a SWT image from a Java BufferedImage.
      Parameters:
      bufferedImage - the image.
      Returns:
      returns a SWT image. If the image is set in the grid with setImage(...) it is disposed by the grid, else it must be disposed by the caller.
